title: Edit Reservation Items
lede: People who own a reservation can now add or remove items from the Edit Booking sheet instead of going to the web app.

sections.heading: After (no matched before)
sections.note: After-only. I did not build a matching before capture. Before, this sheet had no Items row, and its footnote said gear was read-only on the phone. Captured on iPhone 18 Pro Max, iOS 27, light mode, fixture scenarios booking-edit-reservation and booking-edit-items.

shots.cap: New Items row on a reservation.

shots.title: Edit Items
shots.cap: The New Reservation picker with this reservation's items selected. LENS-032 is blocked as unavailable.

changes.h: Items on the Edit Booking sheet
changes.was: Gear was read-only on iOS. Changing it meant going to the web app.
changes.now: Reservations show an Items row with a count. Tapping it opens the same picker as New Reservation, with a Done button.

The picker checks availability without counting this reservation against itself, so conflicting items can't be added. Save stays disabled while items conflict, are still being checked, or none are left.
Still kiosk only. The Items row appears only on reservations.

changes.was: Picked-up items could be removed, and supply counts could be capped below the units already checked out. The server then rejected the save.
changes.now: Picked-up items are locked in the picker. Supply limits count this reservation's held units again, and the Items row shows 'N picked up'.

changes.was: Checked the saved items even after they were edited.

verification: xcodebuild Wisconsin (iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator): BUILD SUCCEEDED
vitest iOS source-contract tests for the changed files: all passed (new checks for locked gear and return-time checks against edited items)
vitest server tests update-booking, collaborator-booking-routes, booking-lifecycle-route-contract: 64/64 passed
Fixture captures inspected (the locked picked-up state was not captured)
notes: I have not tested a signed-in save against the preview server. The server's handling of item edits is covered by the update-booking tests.
